units.rawText: Puzzle? Relax, I'm not here to catch you today. You don't need to be in Purrzle form.

units.rawText: Oh-ho~ Then you must be here for my new sculpture, my most esteemed audience member.

units.rawText: I was just going to talk about our first meeting, but after seeing your Purrzle form... Sigh. My memory of you has been completely awakened; the image is so clear that it's rather hard to forget.

units.rawText: That's that and this is this! One can only blame that conniving fox, my sculptures shall only ever be perfect~

units.rawText: Puzzle pulls back the curtain behind her, revealing a gargantuan statue before me. Unlike her usual abstract style, this one is strikingly different—it's her first piece, albeit now rendered in an extremely realistic style.

units.rawText: Is this... a miniature sculpture of the entire Oasis? I certainly wasn't prepared for this... But I do remember what you said in response to the question of where your inspiration was from, "Those shapes and colors were always there. I simply used my artistic techniques to bring them out."

units.rawText: I never thought you'd remember that, Professor... Yes, the Oasis doesn't need me to add more shapes or colors. All I need to do is sculpt it as it is. That's my definition of perfection.
